sources: Esri World Imagery 44.0483,-71.5598 (700 m square) with the rec.gov site points, 2026-11-23

booking.source: FS page ('Some sites can be reserved online or by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 ... Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis', with a 'Make Reservations Here' link to recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/239417); recreation.gov ('Campsites are available on a first-come, first serve basis and reservations'; notice 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 14); catalog: 17 of 27 sites reservable

fees.source: FS page ('Single Site: $30 per night', 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); recreation.gov notices ('Campsite fee includes parking for two vehicles Additional fee of $6 PER NIGHT ... for EACH additional vehicle(s)'; 'Allow no more than 8 people and 2 vehicles per site'); recreation.gov rates $30 for every site type, 2026 and 2027 peak seasons

sites.source: FS page ('Big Rock Campground has 28 wooded campsites'); recreation.gov catalog (27 sites listed, no site 2): 16 WALK TO (shared parking), 2 TENT ONLY (21, 22), 9 STANDARD NONELECTRIC - RV 40 ft on 1, 3, 4, 11, RV 26 ft on 5, Pop up 20 ft on 7, 9, 14, 15; every typed driveway Back-in. Five sites take a 23-ft rig (3, 5, 11 reservable; 1, 4 first-come)

hookups.source: recreation.gov overview ('Water, electrical and sewage connections are not provided')

facilities.source: FS page ('Vault Toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov ('Vault toilets')

values.note: Mid-May to mid-October; recreation.gov sells 2027 nights May 20 to October 11.

season.source: FS page (Seasons of Use 'Mid-May - Mid-October'); recreation.gov rates ('Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11')

discounts.source: FS page ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note: On the Kancamagus Highway 7 miles east of Lincoln, named for a glacial boulder near the entrance. Most sites are walk-to from shared parking; only sites 1, 3, 4 and 11 (40 ft) and 5 (26 ft) are drive-in spurs a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov 239417 (listing exists; stored 'no rec.gov, first-come always' was wrong): 28 sites, 5 take 23 ft+ (max 40, back-in), 17 of 27 reservable, $30 + $6 per vehicle over 2, 8 people max, vault toilets + water, mid-May to mid-October. booking none/always -> recreation.gov/some_sites. Not waterfront confirmed.

FIT: only 5 of 28 sites take 23 ft+ (1, 3, 4, 11 at 40 ft; 5 at 26 ft); 16 are walk-to and 4 drive-in sites are typed Pop up 20 ft. recreation.gov overview: 'most other sites have suitable parking space available for small trailers and motorhomes' - the catalog's 40-ft lengths outrank that wording. Keep; the note names the sites.

Waterfront: not waterfront confirmed. Esri 44.0483,-71.5598: all site points under continuous canopy north of the Kancamagus Highway; the Hancock Branch runs south of the highway, ~200 m+ from the nearest sites.

Kancamagus pass: FS passes page ('forest campgrounds ... are managed by concessionaire and are not covered by the recreation pass. These areas may require additional fees') - the site fee is the charge; no page says campers need the day-use pass.
Pin 44.04868,-71.56101 (= FS lat/long) sits beside site 13 on the west side of the loop, ~150 m from the site centroid (44.0483,-71.5594); no move.
